checks_run.procedure: Confirm the frozen candidate before reviewing. Check HEAD, that the repository is not shallow, the recomputed candidate id and its diff against the frozen manifest, and that every difference between HEAD and the freeze commit is candidate-excluded metadata. Build a disposable full clone at the freeze commit and recompute the id there too.
checks_run.command: git rev-parse HEAD; git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository; git merge-base --is-ancestor 5f83a33 HEAD; git diff --stat 5f83a33 HEAD; node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG1; node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG1 --diff; git clone /home/user/My-owns $TMPDIR/review-dom5 && git checkout 5f83a33 && node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG1
checks_run.environment: Linux sandbox, node v22.22.2, pnpm 10.33.0; candidate tree /home/user/My-owns and a disposable clone under $TMPDIR (removed afterwards)
checks_run.expected: The recomputed id equals sha256:24eb3779...b50b08e with no added, removed or changed files. HEAD is the freeze commit, or a descendant that changes only candidate-excluded metadata.
checks_run.actual: HEAD is d3fcb89 ('DG1 r5: freeze candidate 24eb377 + round-5 review assignments'), a direct child of the freeze commit 5f83a33. Its diff adds or changes only round-5 assignments, the candidate manifest, stages.json and two QA evidence probes (all candidate-excluded). The repository is not shallow. The working tree and the clone at 5f83a33 both recompute sha256:24eb377939d83b7036e992e647f390b91e030cd6aa18b805b74dea900d50b08e over 390 files, and --diff reports matches=true with nothing added, removed or changed. The candidate and freeze commit therefore match. HEAD differs only by metadata, which review-common.md anticipates.
